sections.title: NY/MA/VT/NH
sections.text: REF MCD 778 SURFACE LOW SWRN ONTARIO WILL DEEPEN AND TRACK ALONG ST LAWRENCE VALLEY TO NRN NH BORDER BY THIS EVENING...AS AN IMPRESSIVE WIND MAX DRIVES EWD ACROSS NY/PA TO SRN ENGLAND. AIR MASS CURRENTLY DESTABILIZING ACROSS NY AS MID LEVEL COOLING AND SURFACE HEATING WORK ON AVAILABLE MOISTURE TO DEVELOP MLCAPES TO 1000 J/KG BY MID AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS WHICH HAVE BEEN ACTIVE JUST N OF BORDER IN WRN NY THIS AM WILL DEVELOP ALONG AND S OF LAKE ONTARIO COAST AS WELL AS ERN LAKE ERIE BY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WITH DEEP LAYER SHEAR OF 60-70K...DAMAGING WINDS ARE INITIALLY THE PRIMARY THREAT AS STORMS MOVE RAPIDLY EWD ACROSS UPSTATE NY. BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON AS LOW CONTINUES TO DEEPEN TO N LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS ERN NY INTO WRN NEW ENGLAND. THIS WILL ENHANCE BOTH THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT AS WELL AS INCREASE TORNADO POTENTIAL.

sections.title: AL/GA/SC
sections.text: MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS MODERATELY STRONG ZONAL FLOW ACROSS MOST OF THE NATION...WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING LOWER MS VALLEY. THIS FEATURE HAS HELPED TO MAINTAIN A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVERNIGHT WITH THE OUTFLOW NOW LOCATED FROM NRN AL SWWD TO SRN AR. THE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY IS MOIST AND MARGINALLY UNSTABLE WITH BOTH 12Z AND MODEL POINT SOUNDINGS SHOWING THE POTENTIAL FOR AFTERNOON MUCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG. CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO RE-INTENSIFY BY MID AFTERNOON AS IT DEVELOPS INTO AL/GA AND EVENTUALLY INTO SC. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY BE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH HAIL MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST CELLS.

sections.title: NC/VA
sections.text: MORNING RAOBS SHOW AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY IS IN PLACE TODAY ACROSS PARTS OF NC AND VA. IN ADDITION NEAR FULL HEATING IS TAKING PLACE WHICH WILL LIKELY LEAD TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WESTERN VA/NC...SPREADING EASTWARD THROUGH THE EVENING. SUFFICIENT WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT WILL PROMOTE ISOLATED SUPERCELL STORMS AND BOWING SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: TX
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP ONCE AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON ALONG SURFACE BOUNDARY FROM CENTRAL INTO NORTHEAST TX. CAPE VALUES IN THE WARM SECTOR WILL RANGE FROM 2000-3000 J/KG. CAP WILL DELAY STORMS DEVELOPING UNTIL LATER THIS AFTERNOON. THOSE STORMS THAT CAN DEVELOP WILL POSE A THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS IN A GENERALLY WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. ..HALES/GRAMS.. 05/09/2009

sections.title: NY/NRN PA AND INTO NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: WIDESPREAD STRONG/SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE MOVING EWD ACROSS NY AND ADJACENT NRN PA/NWRN VT ATTM...AHEAD OF A STRONG MID-LEVEL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE SYSTEM. DESTABILIZATION HAS BEEN LIMITED THIS AFTERNOON...BUT IS BEING OFFSET BY THE STRENGTH OF THE STORM SYSTEM AND ACCOMPANYING FAVORABLE WIND FIELD. DEGREE OF SHEAR SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED/SEVERE STORMS THROUGH AT LEAST EARLY EVENING...BEFORE DIURNAL EFFECTS BEGIN TO SUPPORT WEAKENING CONVECTION. UNTIL THEN...THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL -- ALONG WITH AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO -- WILL CONTINUE/SPREAD EWD ACROSS THIS REGION.

sections.title: NC/VA
sections.text: A CLUSTER STRONG/ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS IS ONGOING ACROSS WRN NC ATTM...WITHIN MOIST/MODERATELY-UNSTABLE AIRMASS AHEAD OF A SHORT-WAVE MID-LEVEL TROUGH APPROACHING THIS REGION. AREA VWP DATA CONFIRMS MODEL FORECASTS OF STRONGER FLOW ALOFT ACROSS THIS REGION...SO EXPECT LOCAL SEVERE THREAT TO CONTINUE INTO EARLY EVENING AS STORMS MOVE EWD ACROSS NC -- AND POSSIBLY DEVELOP ACROSS VA LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: SC/GA/AL
sections.text: MODEST SHEAR/INSTABILITY PERSISTS ACROSS THIS AREA...THOUGH APPARENT SUBSIDENCE IN THE WAKE OF A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH NOW CROSSING NRN AL/SERN TN/NRN GA/THE WRN CAROLINAS IS HINDERING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. HOWEVER...MODELS CONTINUE TO INDICATE STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THIS REGION -- WHICH GIVEN THE AMBIENT ENVIRONMENT WOULD LIKELY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINAL HAIL/WIND. CONFIDENCE IS TOO LOW TO REMOVE SLIGHT RISK FROM THIS REGION...BUT IT APPEARS THAT THIS AREA MAY PROVE TO BE A RELATIVE MINIMUM IN SEVERE THREAT.

sections.title: TX/SRN AR/NRN LA
sections.text: MCS IS ONGOING ATTM FROM THE RED RIVER VALLEY REGION OF NERN TX/SERN OK EWD INTO SRN AR...TO THE COOL SIDE OF A SURFACE FRONT NOW EXTENDING ACROSS THE ARKLATEX REGION. WHILE CAPPING S OF THE FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE TO HINDER WARM SECTOR DEVELOPMENT...STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/LAYER OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ALOFT SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT VIGOROUS STORMS. MODERATE CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR WILL ALSO AID STORM ORGANIZATION/LONGEVITY -- SUGGESTING THAT A THREAT FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY-DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE INTO THE EVENING ACROSS THIS REGION...AND EWD INTO ADJACENT NRN MS. FARTHER SW...CAPPING INCREASES...SO ONCE AGAIN EXPECT WARM SECTOR DEVELOPMENT TO BE LIMITED TO NON-EXISTENT. HOWEVER...STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON OR THIS EVENING WITHIN ZONE OF ISENTROPIC LIFT ATOP THE LOW-LEVEL FRONT WHICH WILL INCREASE THIS EVENING AS A 35 KT SELY LOW-LEVEL JET DEVELOPS. AGAIN -- WITH CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED/ROTATING STORMS...THREAT FOR HAIL AND PERHAPS LOCALLY-SEVERE GUSTS SHOULD INCREASE/EXPAND ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND N TX THROUGH THIS EVENING. ..GOSS.. 05/09/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1106 AM CDT SAT MAY 09 2009/
